title: report nail's -a help text and the -a 0 panic upstream
body: nail's args.rs reads 'allow at most N attempts to recover disjoint clouds', which describes N as retries on top of a first attempt. It is the total, including the first, so -a 0 asks for no attempt at all: the loop never runs, the results stay None, and nail hits an unreachable! at cloud_stage.rs:154 rather than erroring out. One attempt with no recovery is -a 1. This cost an overnight cloud-search run. 837ba60 made the give-up respect max_attempts (it was a hard-coded 4, so -a 10 behaved like -a 5); the wording and the panic remain.
